title: Genuine Zero Uniform Atlas Energy
description: Lean 4 formalization of the native real-camera/Genuine zero identity, the exact empirical C2--C7 camera geometry including the C4/C6 antipodal channels, the sharp critical cutoff-tail expansion with explicit M^(-5/2) remainder, and the resulting collective raw-energy expansion with rational six-camera leading coefficient and explicit O_t(M^(-4)) error. The repository also records transverse Hessian geometry, a strictly positive symbolic projection floor under a nonzero-derivative hypothesis, and conditional passage of supplied uniform coercivity to a supplied limiting energy.
